sources.quote: reads the current state first, and presses only when it differs, then confirms the change by readback
refuses, so the router moves on to the next channel.
A toggle must not be presented as a set.

fixture.note: The 19-track lpm-locale-campaign project with nothing armed, the Mackie Control surface bound, and the server started with LOGIC_PRO_MCP_ARM_KEYCODE set to a value that does not parse, so the Accessibility arm rung refuses arm_key_config_invalid (not terminal) and the router walks on to the MCU rung. Track 15 is strip 7 of bank 1; track 16 sits in the last bank, which Logic stops short at the last strip.
